A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Low-Rank Thinning with matching authors, main sections, and Appendices A–L. Text extraction and visual inspection support reliable comparison of the complete text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v6 reports original attention benchmarks in Tables 3–4, SGD experiments in Figure 1, and two-sample testing experiments in Figure 2, with additional empirical analyses in Appendix L.

after.justification: v7 retains these original experiments and appendix analyses, including revised BigGAN results in Table 4.

M1.justification: The proposed algorithms and appendix pseudocode retain their procedures. Replacing KT-SPLIT with KH in Appendix I.1 aligns the proof with the halving routine already specified in both versions; it does not introduce a method component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ImageNet classification, BigGAN image generation, mortgage classification with reordered SGD, and Higgs two-sample testing. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The attention comparisons retain Exact, Performer, Reformer, KDEformer, and ScatterBrain. The SGD comparisons retain RR and both CD-GraB variants, while the testing comparisons retain Subsampling and W-Block.

E3.justification: Appendix L.1 revises the reported BigGAN execution environment from 1000 GB to 100 GB of host RAM. Model configurations, metrics, batch sizes, and timing procedures remain unchanged. This is a reported environment revision; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The gradient rank and singular-value analysis in Figure L.1 and the CTT error-inflation analysis in Figure L.2 are unchanged. No ablation, robustness study, or supplementary analytical experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Seed counts, batch counts, and uncertainty-reporting practices remain unchanged, including five-seed accuracy/SGD summaries and 1000-trial testing summaries. Revised standard deviations in Table 4 are changes to result values, not statistical procedures.

E6.justification: Table 4 updates all six runtimes and the KDEformer and ScatterBrain FID/IS entries. For example, Thinformer runtime changes from 2.66 ± 0.01 to 2.69 ± 0.01 ms, and ScatterBrain FID changes from 38.78 to 38.47. Thinformer's quality scores, Table 4 rankings, and empirical results elsewhere remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Theorem 2 changes the constant inside its logarithm from 12 to 8, matching the existing Appendix F derivation. Appendices B.6.4 and F.1 replace incorrect equality steps with inequalities, and Appendix I.1 corrects proof references to the halving routine and kernel matrix. The central results and assumptions remain intact.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and impact statement retain the same contributions: general low-rank thinning guarantees and applications to attention approximation, SGD reordering, and near-linear two-sample testing.

C2.justification: Interpretations of low-rank adaptivity, attention approximation conditions, SGD convergence, and testing power remain unchanged. The practical qualifications concerning the SBW experiment in Appendix L.2 are also retained.

D1.justification: Appendix L.1 changes the BigGAN server's reported RAM from 1000 GB to 100 GB. Software versions, CPU/GPU specifications, hyperparameter tables, and code-access information otherwise match. Whether the RAM revision corrects a typo or describes different hardware is unstated.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Hoeffding's collected-works citation is replaced by the original journal citation, and the Steinwart–Christmann book metadata is corrected; these identify the same underlying works.

P1.justification: There are limited punctuation, heading, and proof-prose edits, including a streamlined Appendix B.5 passage. Proposition B.9 moves beside its introductory description. The overall section organization and narrative remain stable.

P2.justification: Theorem/proof typography and appendix page layout are adjusted. Appendix tables shift vertically, and Section L.3 moves between the existing Figures L.1 and L.2. Figures are not redrawn, and table rows and columns are retained.

improvement.justification: Theorem 2 now agrees with its Appendix F derivation, and incorrect equality steps in Appendices B.6.4 and F.1 are corrected. These changes and bibliographic corrections improve precision and traceability. The small Table 4 revisions do not establish a same-setting performance improvement, and the overall quality gain is limited.
